scope: Checklist only; no parser execution or C# compilation claimed.

checks.requirement: Exact root object/required fields; root array/null/scalar rejected.
Missing any required root field rejected rather than silently defaulted.
Unknown root field and case-collision alias rejected.
Duplicate root field rejected, including escaped-key equivalent.
Explicit empty arrays accepted; null/missing required arrays rejected.
Jagged allowed cells, null row and scalar row rejected.
Every row requires exactly its specified keys and matching scalar types.
Duplicate/unknown fields rejected in all three row types.
Int fields require integer tokens in signed32 range; fractional/exponent/overflow rejected.
Revision uses signed64 range; >2^53 values do not pass through double rounding.
Float fields are JSON numbers and finite after invariant-culture parse; exponent overflow rejected.
Positive cellSize and postSpacing3or4 enforced by semantic validation.
PackageId/current art pin/wholeboard flag validated before persisted BoardAsset mutation.
Recognized JSON escapes and four-hex Unicode escapes decoded; bad escape/literal control char rejected.
Escaped property names normalize before duplicate/key matching.
Trailing data/comments/extra commas/malformed number rejected; optional leading BOM behavior explicit.
Depth bounded; malformed object/array separators rejected.
Unknown family/group key and duplicate group IDs/claims rejected by existingPlanner validation.
Missing one group footprint allowedcell rejects entire board; no partial authoring asset save.
Strict importer validated result has defensive copies; failed import does not replace valid owned BoardAsset.
